data.title: About Erick
bio: Erick was born and raised in New York, he has been living in New Jersey for 4 years.  When he’s not working as a Real Estate Agent, Erick enjoys the outdoors, hiking, and chess, as he is a former competitive chess player.  Erick is excited to join Green Light Realty, a local agency dedicated to the future of our clients and communities.

He is ready to help individuals and families find or sell their home.  Erick graduated with a Bachelors in Business Administration.  He has worked with Real Estate Developers and Funds for the past 4 years, helping them secure capital sources through industry conferences.
He is excited to be working as a licensed agent in order to serve everybody’s needs better.  Call him anytime, he is always available to talk and answer any questions you may have.
